data.research_question: 提出MolMiner，一种基于片段、几何感知且顺序无关的自回归模型，用于支持12个理化性质的高维条件控制分子设计。
data.why_hard: 现有自回归模型通常依赖固定展开顺序，且很少在生成过程中整合动态几何信息，导致泛化能力受限。

evidence.research_question: We introduce MolMiner, a fragment-based, geometry-aware, and order-agnostic autoregressive model for molecular design.

data.abstract: We introduce MolMiner, a fragment-based, geometry-aware, and order-agnostic autoregressive model for molecular design. MolMiner supports high-dimensional conditional control over twelve physicochemical and structural properties from partial specifications, constructs molecules via symmetry-aware fragment attachments, and conditions each generation step on force-field-relaxed three-dimensional geometry of the partial structure. Conditional control emerges without auxiliary property losses. On targeted property windows, conditioning lifts hit rates by up to 5.25× over unconditional generation and 3.5× over the training distribution itself — overriding the model’s intrinsic biases — at the cost of a small reduction in unconditional distributional fidelity. MolMiner unifies dynamic geometry, symmetry handling, order-agnostic generation, and scalable multi-property conditioning within a single framework.

algorithms.name: MolMiner
problems_solved: 解决分子生成中化学有效性难以保证的问题
解决固定生成顺序导致的泛化能力不足问题

algorithms.mechanism: 基于片段的自回归生成，结合力场弛豫的3D几何信息与对称感知的片段连接，支持任意顺序的片段组装。
algorithms.why_it_works: 片段级操作显式强制化学有效性，动态3D几何提供物理约束，无序生成策略作为数据增强提升泛化。
applicable_to: 高通量筛选中的候选分子生成

limitations: 条件生成导致无条件分布保真度略有下降
